info.name: Livestock ERP Farm Animal View API
info.description: Separate Postman collection for Farm Animal View APIs supporting FARM-US-004 through FARM-US-007: All/Batch/Individual tabs, search/filter options, animal list rows, and animal detail payloads. All endpoints use /api/v1 and require farms.view.

request.description: Logs in and stores the bearer token in access_token.

originalRequest.description: Logs in and stores the bearer token in access_token.

request.description: Bootstraps the Farm Animal View screen with farm context, All/Batch/Individual tab counts, filter options, selected filters, and row action names.
